answers.answerContent: ဘုရင် သုဒ္ဓေါဒန and မိဖုရား မာယာဒေဝီ were the parents of the child, although the mother died only days after the birth.

After birth, he walked 7 steps even though he was only an infant, and asserted dominance. He also meditated under a tree in deep concentration in meditation. He also got an amazing future prediction from astrologers and foretellers.
foretellers, astrologers, and people like Asita worshipped the baby.

Since I'm an only child, and I haven't asked that question to my parents before, I can only assume that in my case, I was cleaned up and whatnot and put in a crib in the hospital before getting driven home.
"လောကတွင် ငါသာအမြတ်ဆုံး၊ လောကတွင် ငါသာ အကြီးဆုံး၊ လောကတွင် ငါသာ အချီးမွမ်းအပ်ဆုံး".
I think it means something like someone who fulfilled the goal.
He was meditating unlike the other children around him.
they said he would wither be a great ruler or the Buddha.
